errors.text: The predicted HCP trend contradicts the target: the hypothesis predicts HCP atoms decrease at 1200 K, whereas the target reports an increasing HCP atom fraction with temperature.
The predicted dislocation-line-length peak at 600 K conflicts with the stated reduction in dislocation density at 600 K.
The falsification rule is logically reversed: if suppressing amorphization also suppresses the friction spike, that would support, not falsify, the proposed amorphization mechanism.
Lattice disorder is treated as demonstrated amorphization without direct supporting evidence; the cited studies concern different materials and deformation geometries.
